features.title: Plugin Manifest Core (plugin.json schema + validation)
acceptance: JSON schema for plugin.json validates required fields (name, version, displayName, description, skills, agents, mcpServers, hooks, commands, logo)
Validator script checks plugin.json against schema
Name pattern enforced: ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9])?$

features.title: Skill Frontmatter Parsing & Validation
acceptance: SKILL.md frontmatter parsed (YAML)
Required fields: name (lowercase/hyphen), description
Name must match parent folder name
Optional: paths, disable-model-invocation, icon, color, metadata, displayName

features.title: Local Plugin Symlink Support
acceptance: Plugins in ~/.cursor/plugins/local/ load via symlinks
Realpath resolution for plugin discovery
Broken symlinks handled gracefully with error reporting
Symlink status tracked in plugin metadata
implementation: scripts/validate-plugin.mjs (updated to work with discovered plugins)

features.title: PR Review Canvas Diff Renderer Fix
acceptance: Line numbers computed from raw diff hunk headers before filtering
Import filtering opt-in with visible collapsed rows
Whitespace-only collapsing limited to trim-only comparison

features.title: OAuth Authentication Flow for Connectors
acceptance: GitHub plugin provides sign-in link on Authenticate button
Gmail plugin includes gmail.settings.basic scope
Todoist/X plugins authenticate correctly

features.title: Extended CI Validation
acceptance: CI triggers on all plugin files (SKILL.md, hooks.json, mcp.json, agents)
Root package.json with pinned dependencies
Validator checks path existence, frontmatter parse, mcp.json placeholders
Script test suites run in CI (bun test, tsc)
